title: Question Story · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Question Story · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a fictional character and a simple goal. The lead tells a short story that answers who, where and what happened. The group can identify the character, setting and event. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Question Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group can identify the character, setting and event.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group can identify the character, setting and event.
